gpu_validation.registry_setup_change: The coordinator uses bounded CPU registry approval. Original identities match in all supported heights under CPU, research GPU and standard GPU feature configurations. No fresh GPU proof or throughput measurement.
gpu_validation.pool_registry_change: Pool identity is checked once with bounded CPU metadata construction and retained with its immutable registry. Every result still uses the original numerical verifier; no fresh GPU proof or throughput result.
gpu_validation.worker_registry_change: Worker startup and input verification reuse immutable CPU registry metadata. Numerical verification stays on CPU. No fresh GPU proof or throughput result.
gpu_validation.session_registry_change: Session self/child checks reuse immutable CPU registry identity. Original numerical verifier and proof-generation arithmetic are preserved. No fresh GPU proof or throughput result.

implementation: A private session helper reuses the registry/profile binding established at construction; both fields remain immutable to callers.
Post-proof self-verification and merge/finalize child verification retain mode, expected profile, exact public statement and original numerical checks.
A source reconstruction audit preserves the entire previous file except the private helper, its four callers and the new test module declaration.
Public direct registry verification and session construction remain unchanged; no wire, proof, circuit, parameter, backend or memory-floor changes.

session_registry_lifetimes.finalizer_scope: Existing six- and twelve-key finalizers only; the five-key family still rejects finalization.
session_registry_lifetimes.accounting_scope: Reduction in cumulative allocation requests; no complete process lifetime or RSS model.
session_registry_lifetimes.allocation_observer: Cumulative allocation requests, not simultaneous peak, RSS, latency or transaction throughput.

limitations: Direct generic session construction, recovery/restore and other direct registry paths retain reference identity compilation and need complete enclosing phase accounting.
Complete worker/coordinator admission, bootstrap/caller ownership, allocator metadata/slack, stacks, entropy, tracing and Rayon/runtime RSS remain unfinished.
Three targeted fresh CPU empty-node proofs cover five-, six- and twelve-key families; ordinary regressions exercise additional proofs without an exhaustive fresh-proof count.
Four full-size desktop RTX 5080 GPU proofs remain inherited from 9.106. No new GPU proof, throughput comparison or sustained campaign was run.

Shared/job floors remain 512 MiB/337 MiB. Broader workloads/live caches, nonempty-child full-size merges, five matched pairs, 24 hours AND 150 completed roots, multiple GPUs and AMD/Metal remain open.
